Name: R1a_pick_end
What it is: Train as usual, then use the saved version whose own practice episodes did best.

Name: R1b_rollback
What it is: If the recent practice success drops 20 points below its best, go back to the best version.

Name: R1c_both
What it is: Rollback during training and pick the best version at the end.

Name: R2a_depth
What it is: Add a getting-warmer reward from the insertion depth reading.

Name: R2b_torque
What it is: Add a getting-warmer reward for less wrist twisting.

Name: R2c_both
What it is: Add getting-warmer rewards from both depth and low torque.

Name: R2d_aim_torque
What it is: Torque getting-warmer reward on the aim-only corrector (normal camera error).

Name: R3a_search_every
What it is: Learner picks wiggle width, sideways lean and extra push every step after contact.

Name: R3b_search_hold10
What it is: Learner picks the same search settings once every 10 steps and they are held.

Name: R3c_search_plus_move
What it is: Search settings every step plus the plain movement correction on top.

Name: H31_no_wiggle_check
What it is: Old policy plus a fixed circular wiggle once touching and stalled (no learning), size 0 mm.

Name: H31_hand_wiggle_0.05mm
What it is: Old policy plus a fixed circular wiggle once touching and stalled (no learning), size 0.05 mm.

Name: H31_hand_wiggle_0.1mm
What it is: Old policy plus a fixed circular wiggle once touching and stalled (no learning), size 0.1 mm.

Name: H31_hand_wiggle_0.2mm
What it is: Old policy plus a fixed circular wiggle once touching and stalled (no learning), size 0.2 mm.
